newsitem.title: USA: ENTERGY SEES $229 MLN WINDFALL TAX LIABILITY.
newsitem.headline: ENTERGY SEES $229 MLN WINDFALL TAX LIABILITY.

text.p: Entergy Corp said in a regulatory filing Friday that it expects its liability under a proposed U.K. windfall profits tax to be about $229 million.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the New Orleans-based utility said the one-time tax liability, with a corresponding charge against income, was recorded in July. A company spokesman noted that it would be reflected in the company's third-quarter results.
Entergy is subject to the one-time U.K. windfall tax on privatized utilities due its acquisition of London Electricity Plc in February.

The company also reported that a reduction in the U.K. corporate tax rate would result in a one-time reduction in income tax expense of about $65 million to adjust London Electricity's deferred income tax liability to the new rate.
The decrease in the income tax expense was also recorded in July, Entergy's quarterly filing said.
The spokesman also noted that the company recorded 100 percent of the windfall tax liability in July even though half of it will be collected this year and the other half next year.
